title: SecurityEventSequenceV1
description: Hub -> model-slot input. Stage 0 freezes the envelope only; the security ontology lives in the opaque 'attributes' map and is Stage 1's subject. Breaking changes take a new $id (…v2), never a version bump.

window_capacity.description: Hard bound on the window. Endpoint state, queues and caches must be bounded; an unbounded sequence is an unbounded allocation on a 2 GB host.

truncated.description: True when the bounded window dropped earlier events. Lets a slot distinguish 'nothing happened before' from 'we stopped looking', so a bounded buffer cannot silently become a false negative.

evidence_ref.description: A pointer to raw evidence held outside the model. Evidence is referenced, never inlined, and the digest binds the reference to exact bytes so lineage survives compression.

boot_id.description: Monotonic timestamps are only comparable within one boot.

kind.description: Coarse source-level label such as 'process.exec'. NOT a threat class: nothing in the input contract may encode a verdict.

attributes.description: Deliberately opaque string map. Stage 0 non-goal: do not hard-code a final threat taxonomy. Stage 1 formalises these keys without renegotiating Stage 0 measurement rules.
